content.text:
Updated Friday detection to recognize “Friday” and “Fri” case-insensitively, while preserving ISO-date support. Friday slots now consistently exclude starts after 15:00, but allow 15:00 when otherwise valid.

Preserved working hours, 15-minute intervals, and conflict checks. All added checks passed.
